name: cc-plugins-igorlabworks
description: Opinionated personal plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: core-context
plugins.description: Injects global coding-rule context files when editing code or running commands

plugins.name: python
plugins.description: Python coding guidelines and best practices

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript coding guidelines and best practices

plugins.name: svelte
plugins.description: Svelte coding guidelines and best practices

plugins.name: rust
plugins.description: Rust coding guidelines and best practices

plugins.name: golang
plugins.description: Go coding guidelines and best practices

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Plan-mode support: interrogation skill, UML-anchored plan document conventions, and PDF export of the approved plan

plugins.name: shell-guard
plugins.description: Auto-rejects common, known-annoying shell command patterns (complexity/efficiency guard, not a security boundary)

plugins.name: visualize
plugins.description:
Create beautiful, self-contained HTML visualizations from any content or idea. Slide decks, dashboards, infographics, flowcharts, timelines, and more.

(adapted from `careerhackeralex/visualize`)

plugins.name: quality-inspector
plugins.description: Reports newly-introduced quality findings around edit bursts, via belphegor

plugins.name: plan-review
plugins.description: Preloads relevant context into the Plan subagent and reviews plans against your conventions before exit

plugins.name: away-mode
plugins.description: Auto-denies every permission prompt with a standing away-from-keyboard message, so Claude keeps working within auto-allowed tools instead of stalling

plugins.name: expository-budget
plugins.description: Holds every code file to a per-file ceiling on comments and docstrings; the ceiling falls as prose is removed and only you can raise it
